data.content:
# Pre-Selected Internal Candidate

Requisition was publicly advertised to satisfy corporate policy or legal compliance while an internal employee was already earmarked for the role.

### Structural Context
- **Actor:** `policy`
- **Nature:** `incentive`
- **Removability:** `none`

### Causal Relations
- Masks `mech.stronger_competing_candidate_in_final_cohort` — Stronger Competing Candidate in Final Cohort

### Non-Inferences
- Cannot be asserted as fact without internal hiring log confirmation.
data.summary: Requisition was publicly advertised to satisfy corporate policy or legal compliance while an internal employee was already earmarked for the role.

specimens.label: Final round, an aside

lines.speaker: Candidate
lines.text: How many people are you seeing for this?

lines.speaker: Hiring manager
lines.text: You are the third external. There is also someone internal who has been covering part of the scope since spring.

lines.speaker: Candidate
lines.text: Understood. Is that a formal candidacy?

lines.speaker: Hiring manager
lines.text: It is. We post externally regardless — that is policy.

specimens.reading: Nothing improper is described. The posting is real, the process is real, and the odds were set before the first external application arrived.

perspectives.sees: A funded requisition, and a posting rule that applies to every requisition regardless of who already works inside the scope.
perspectives.reads: Consistency across hires is what makes a process defensible. A rule that holds for all requisitions cannot be switched off for one.
perspectives.does: Publishes externally as the rule requires. What happens to the external pipeline afterwards is not reported back to this layer.

perspectives.sees: Someone already covering part of the scope, and a slate of external candidates each assessed inside the hours the loop allows.
perspectives.reads: Work already observed and work inferred from an interview are not the same evidence. Only one person on the slate has been watched doing the work itself.
perspectives.does: Runs the external loop as posted and assesses each candidate against a bar the internal work already meets.

perspectives.sees: A live posting, scheduled rounds, and interviewers who prepare. The composition of the slate is not stated.
perspectives.reads: Nothing in the process distinguishes it from one that is open. Whether a requisition is already promised internally is not a field the candidate is shown.
perspectives.does: Can ask at the final round how many are being seen and whether any are internal. That answer is available on request and absent without one.

non_inferences: Cannot be asserted as fact without internal hiring log confirmation.
